notes.text: On the sheet numbered 52 at the lower left, the author writes (62), an equivalence between (M_[G], Gamma!) and B(Gamma!_S0). This is a reading of the written statement only; no equivalence was proved or checked.

The live formula (63) gives dim tot(G)=3(g-1)+nu=3(h1(G)-1)+nu, with Card I beneath nu. A slanted margin writes g=sum-alpha g-alpha+h1 and puts zero under a bracket attached to g-alpha. The earlier cancelled formula is not reliably recoverable and remains explicitly tentative, including its initial 3/comparison and terminal nu. The opening prose has the masculine égal as written.

The author proceeds to enumerate ambient dimension at most two and says this forces h1 in {0,1}. In case h1=0 he writes that G is a tree, the dimension is nu-3, and 3<=nu<=5. He argues that a tree other than one vertex or one segment has at least three ends of marked weight at least two, hence nu>=6. He then draws three cases with weights 3; 2,2; and 2,1,2, and nu/dimension pairs 3/0, 4/1 and 5/2. The right-hand line configurations and all labels are reproduced. These claims were transcribed, not subjected to a proof or completeness check.

A separate local arithmetic check used only the three written graph weights: 3, 2+2, and 2+1+2 total 3, 4, and 5; subtracting three gives 0, 1, and 2, matching the three dimension labels in (64). This checks these three numerical substitutions only, not the dimension formula, the tree argument, or completeness of the enumeration. No transcription choice was forced by this calculation.
